top_signals.title: Boeing locks in 7-year deal to triple PAC-3 MSE seeker output
top_signals.summary: The agreement follows a framework deal that was announced in April. Production will span seven years and be completed at Boeing’s Huntsville facility.

top_signals.title: GPIF Said to Have Skipped Allocation Talks at September Meet
top_signals.summary: Japan’s Government Pension Investment Fund did not discuss its portfolio allocation at a board meeting held in September, according to sources familiar with the matter.

top_signals.title: Japan's Takaichi Pitches Food Tax Cut, Investment Plan
